title: docs(adr): ADR-0019 records that a flat composeStacks and a packages[] body are judged since 2026-11-13

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X4e82tcKptpRRoyvCJDwBeL)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0019 在 2026-11-12 的执行记录里写着「两种形状不受检查:扁平的 `composeStacks`,和手工拼的 `packages[]` 包体」。这句改成当日的读数(过去时),并在其后新增一段「自 2026-11-13 起,组合与 `packages[]` 包体都受检查」,逐条写明 #32898、#33074、#33122 三次合并各自检查了什么;状态行的「已落地」也补上这三次合并及其提交号。
- 为什么改:这句话两半在 `main` 上都已不成立:扁平组合把两个以上应用放到同一个 app/module 包名下会被拒(`STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`,422),手工拼的包体也按包分别检查单应用和命名空间前缀。照着旧文字读的作者或 AI 会以为这些形状不受检查。
- 风险与回滚:只改决策记录文字,不动代码、协议和技能包;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md` D3 修订说明下的「Enforced for compositions and `packages[]` bodies since 2026-11-13」一段;再看第 3 行状态行新增的那半句。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`,预期 exit 0、「anchors across 156 records resolve」。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`docs/adr/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md`, D3, the 2026-11-12 note "Enforced for modules since 2026-11-12".** Its sentence "The check reads one `defineStack` call. Two shapes are not judged (#32810): a flat `composeStacks` … and a hand-built `packages[]` body." is rewritten as the reading at that merge, in the past tense, and points to the next paragraph: "At this merge the check read one `defineStack` call, and two shapes were not judged (#32810): … Both are judged since 2026-11-13; see the next paragraph." The rest of that paragraph is unchanged.
- **New dated paragraph "Enforced for compositions and `packages[]` bodies since 2026-11-13."**, following the file's own convention (the 2026-11-12 note keeps the paragraph before it "as written" and adds a dated note). One bullet per merge:
  - #32898 (`0b23b2a0c4`): `composeStacks` refuses a flat composition (`'last'`, `'first'` or an index) whose kept manifest is an `app` or `module` package and that brings two or more apps, `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` (422), naming each app and its input; the remedy is `manifest: 'preserve'`; every `packages[]` body of a composition is held to one app; a one-input composition is handed back unjudged.
  - #33074 (`2c98485db5`): changes only how strict `defineStack` counts the top level of a `packages[]` stack. Before, every top-level app counted against `manifest.id`; since, the residual rule #32898 gave `composeStacks` (top-level apps no body declares count against `manifest.id` beside that id's own body). Bodies are judged as before, per body since #32898.
  - #33122 (`5b2ec820c8`): strict `defineStack` judges namespace prefixes per body against the body's own namespace, residual top-level objects against `manifest.namespace`, `STACK_NAMESPACE_PREFIX_INVALID`; a body with no namespace is not judged.
  - What stays unjudged at `defineStack` (other package types, no manifest, `strict: false`, the last now judged at `composeStacks`), and the placement sentence, which stands (measured, below).
- **Status line, "Landed in spec".** After the #32586 clause: "and the same rule on a flat `composeStacks` and on every `packages[]` body (#32898, merged 2026-11-13 as `0b23b2a0c4`; #33074, merged 2026-11-13 as `2c98485db5`), and the namespace-prefix rule judged per `packages[]` body (#33122, merged 2026-11-13 as `5b2ec820c8`)."
- Not touched: the D3 reasons, the 2026-11-12 "Enforced today, and not yet." paragraph, ADR-0130 (the order's surface is this file only), and `skills/**` (PR #33475 teaches the flat-compose fact there).

## Why

Read on `origin/main` `b392ff7b`, not from the card:

- `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`: `collectComposedSingleAppErrors` and `flatSingleAppFinding` (flat result: every app counts against the one kept manifest), `SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES` = `app`, `module`, `SINGLE_APP_COMPOSE_REMEDY` (names `manifest: 'preserve'`), `collectPackageBodySingleAppErrors` (each body by its own `type`, `id`, `apps`), `validateSingleApp` and `residualSingleAppFinding` (one judge for both doors), `namespacePrefixErrors` (per body, residual top level), `composeStacks`' `stacks.length === 1` early return.
- `examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts` composes with `manifest: 'preserve'`.
- Attribution per PR, read from each merge commit's tree: `residualSingleAppFinding`, `flatSingleAppFinding` and `collectPackageBodySingleAppErrors` exist at `0b23b2a0c4` (#32898), where `validateSingleApp` does not call the residual judge; it does at `2c98485db5` (#33074); `namespacePrefixErrors` first exists at `5b2ec820c8` (#33122).
- Each merge commit is an ancestor of `origin/main` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor`, exit 0 for all three, after deepening the shallow clone).
- One probe against `packages/spec/dist` built from `b392ff7b`, not kept as a test:

  | Shape | Answer |
  |:--|:--|
  | flat `composeStacks` (default `'last'`) of two module stacks with one app each | refused, `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` 422 |
  | the same under `manifest: 'preserve'` | accepted |
  | hand-built `packages[]` body (module) with two apps, `defineStack` | refused, `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` 422 |
  | hand-built body, namespace `svc`, object `crm_case` | refused, `STACK_NAMESPACE_PREFIX_INVALID` 422 |
  | control: same body with `svc_case` | accepted |
  | placement: module with no objects, app names `crm_case` | accepted |
  | placement: object-less body's app names a sibling body's object, `defineStack` and `'preserve'` compose | accepted |

  The placement sentence therefore stands, as the order asked to measure.

Ruling: Leehom 2026-11-14T21:21:06Z 「开放 p3卡认领」 (p3 cards open for claiming); scope widened to both halves by the skills seat's note 6884985712 on the card.

## Acceptance notes

- **The 2026-11-12 paragraph is edited, not kept verbatim.** The order asks for both "rewrite the whole sentence" and "keep the dated paragraph as the reading at that date". Rewriting the one sentence into the past tense, with a pointer to the new note, does both: the paragraph still reads as at #32586's merge, and no present-tense sentence on the page is false.
- No out-of-scope findings.

## Verification

Head `691fe886` (round 1, after contract review 6885553305; round 0 was `c72ef404`), base `origin/main` `b392ff7b`.
